input.summary: Implemented the Task Management API in TypeScript using only Node.js built-in modules. The system includes multiple decoupled services (User, Project, Task, Comment, Notification) that communicate via an event bus. An API router handles HTTP requests and delegates to the appropriate services. The implementation adheres to all specified architectural rules, including no cross-service imports, service-owned data stores, and strict task status transitions. A demo script is included to showcase the end-to-end functionality.
